frame: GLB selected scene coordinates before external instance placement

reconstruction.purpose: Authored approximate geometry and reused parts filling gaps in source CAD; provenance and collision accuracy must remain explicit.

geometry.purpose: Physical housings, structures and moving parts.

markings.purpose: Text, logos, paint sheets and visual decals; classification does not disable collision.

lights.purpose: LED and other luminous surfaces, controlled by semantic channels.

collision.purpose: Optional collision helper geometry for inspection; never inferred from thin surfaces.

debug.purpose: Joint axes, target-frame markers and other authored diagnostic geometry.

decoration.purpose: Reviewed text and logos at any elevation; excluded from collision.

layer_policy: Visibility categories only; collision exclusion requires explicit collision=false on decoration.
